title: 段落匹配的同义改写
goal: 识别同义改写并核对主体与关系。

points.label: 识别不同表达中的同一信息
核对改写前后的主体与关系

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲
sources.used: 阅读课程内容与材料形式

body.p: 同义改写用不同的词语或句式表达同一信息。词语和句式改变后，施事、对象、逻辑关系和程度仍与原文一致。

body.box:
The council provided books to schools.
Schools received books from the council.

body.p: provided 换成 received 后，主语从 The council 变为 Schools。两句都表示议会提供图书、学校接收图书。

cards.title: 词语和词性变化
rows: The town carried out an expansion of the library.
There is a difference between the two reports.

cards.title: 句式和范围变化
rows: The trees were planted by volunteers.
The proposal was rejected by the committee.
The meal included apples and pears.
The drawer contained pens and pencils.

cards.title: 句间关系与核对
rows: Rain fell. The match was canceled because of it.
Rain caused the match to be canceled.
The shelf was high. A ladder was needed to reach it.
A ladder was needed because the shelf was high.
The museum lent a painting to the school.
The school borrowed a painting from the museum.
A number of visitors used the stairs.
The drawer contained pens and pencils.

body.box:
A charity lent musical instruments to local schools. It also repaired damaged instruments at no charge.

1. Local schools lent instruments to the charity for free repairs.
2. Local schools borrowed instruments from a charity that repaired damaged ones free of charge.
3. The charity sold repaired instruments to local schools.
4. All local schools repaired instruments for the charity.

body.p: 第二项的 borrowed from 对应 lent to，free of charge 对应 at no charge。出借和维修的仍是慈善机构，借入乐器的仍是学校。
第一项沿用 charity、schools 和 instruments，却把出借方向颠倒。第三项把出借改为出售，第四项改变了维修者。

groups.text: The gardener watered the young trees.

items.stem: Which statement preserves the same action?
options: The young trees were planted by the gardener.
The young trees were watered by the gardener.
The gardener had the young trees watered by others.
The older trees were watered by the gardener.
items.why: 原文是 The gardener watered the young trees。第二项改成被动句，浇水的人和被浇的树都没有变。

groups.text: The library's collection included maps and atlases.

options: The collection included atlases but no maps.
The library's maps and atlases were given away.
The collection consisted only of maps and atlases.
The collection included geographical materials.
items.why: 原文是 included maps and atlases。第四项把 maps and atlases 概括为 geographical materials。第三项加了 only，原文的 included 没有这层意思。

groups.text: Some residents opposed the proposal, while others supported it.

items.stem: Which statement preserves the extent of opposition?
options: A number of residents objected to the proposal.
Every resident in the area objected to the proposal.
No residents had an opinion on the proposal.
Most of the residents were in favor of the proposal.
items.why: 原文是 Some residents opposed the proposal。第一项用 A number of 改写 Some，范围没有扩大。原文只说 others supported it，没有说支持的人占多数。

groups.text: The storm damaged the roof. Repairs closed the hall for a week.

items.stem: Which statement preserves the cause of the closure?
options: The hall closed because the storm lasted a week.
The roof was damaged by repairs to the hall.
The hall was closed for a week while repairs were made.
The storm closed the hall for a week before repairs began.
items.why: 依据是 Repairs closed the hall for a week。第三项说明大厅关闭是因为维修，时长一周。第四项把关闭的原因换成了暴风雨。

groups.text: The train was not late; it arrived at the scheduled time.

options: The train arrived before its scheduled time.
The train arrived exactly when it was due.
The train departed after its scheduled time.
The train arrived late at the station.
items.why: not late 和 arrived at the scheduled time 都说明火车准时到达。第二项用 exactly when it was due 改写了这一点。

groups.text: The school sent the museum photographs for an exhibition.

items.stem: Which statement preserves who supplied the photographs?
options: The museum sent the school photographs for an exhibition.
The school received photographs from the museum.
The school displayed the museum's photographs.
The museum received photographs from the school.
items.why: school sent 对应 museum received，供应方仍是学校。

groups.text: The committee approved the plan after examining its cost.

options: The plan was approved after its cost had been examined.
The plan's cost was examined by the committee after it had approved the plan.
The committee rejected the plan because of its cost.
The plan was approved without a cost examination.
items.why: after examining its cost 对应 after its cost had been examined。

groups.text: The local collection contains violins and cellos.

items.stem: Which statement follows from the passage?
options: The collection contains only violins.
The collection contains musical instruments.
The collection contains no string instruments.
The collection contains cellos but no violins.
items.why: violins and cellos 都属于 musical instruments。

groups.text: The path was blocked. Walkers therefore used a different route.

items.stem: Which statement combines the same information?
options: Walkers blocked the path to make a different route.
Walkers used the blocked path despite the closure.
Walkers took another route because the path was blocked.
The path was blocked because walkers used a different route.
items.why: therefore 说明道路阻塞是原因，改走别的路是结果。第三项用 because 合并两句，因果方向不变。第四项把因果颠倒了。

groups.text: The company supplied protective gloves to its laboratory workers.

items.stem: Which statement preserves the direction of supply?
options: The workers supplied protective gloves to the company.
The laboratory supplied protective gloves to the workers.
The company received gloves from its laboratory workers.
The workers received protective gloves from the company.
items.why: 原文是 The company supplied protective gloves to its laboratory workers。第四项把 company supplied 改成 workers received，提供方和接收方都没有变。

groups.text: A few students attended the optional workshop after class.

items.stem: Which statement preserves the number described?
options: Every student in the class attended the optional workshop.
A small number of students attended the workshop.
No students attended the optional workshop.
Most of the students attended the optional workshop.
items.why: 原文是 A few students attended。第二项用 A small number of 改写 A few，两者都指少数学生。

groups.text: The old hall was not open during the repairs; its doors were closed.

items.stem: Which statement preserves the hall's condition?
options: The hall was closed while repairs were under way.
The hall remained open while repairs were under way.
The hall was closed only after the repairs were finished.
The repairs ended when the hall's doors opened.
items.why: 原文是 was not open during the repairs 和 its doors were closed。第一项用 closed while repairs were under way 改写，时间仍是维修期间。
